notes: Separate-account manager's performance page with three composites: gross-only header figures, a long-lived composite shown only since inception without 1-, 5- and 10-year periods, and an undated unqualified ranking, set against a correctly paired gross/net statement and a young composite that properly substitutes its life for the ten-year period.

planted.span: Dividend Growth Equity: 14.62% over one year, 12.07% over five years and 11.84% over ten years, annualized, for periods ended December 31, 2025, gross of fees.
planted.explanation: The page header gives the composite's one-, five- and ten-year gross returns alone, while the corresponding net figures appear only further down the page, so net is not presented with at least equal prominence.

planted.span: Since its April 1, 2009 inception through December 31, 2025, the Intermediate Tax-Exempt Composite returned 3.28% annualized gross of fees and 2.76% annualized net of fees.
planted.explanation: A separate-account composite in existence since 2009 (not a private fund) is shown only for its full since-inception period, omitting the required 1-, 5- and 10-year periods, which appear nowhere on the page.

planted.span: Named to the Penwarden Adviser Review list of Top 50 Independent Advisers in the Mid-Atlantic, Ardwell & Tamsett has served Virginia families for more than two decades.
planted.explanation: The third-party ranking names the rater but gives no date it was given, no period it was based on, and no statement about whether the firm paid in connection with obtaining or using it, and none of these appear elsewhere on the page.

decoys.span: For the ten years ended December 31, 2025, the composite returned 11.84% annualized gross of fees and 10.72% annualized net of fees.
decoys.why_ok: Gross and net are stated in the same sentence with equal prominence, and the table beneath gives both for the 1-, 5-, 10-year and since-inception periods.

decoys.span: Over the one year ended December 31, 2025, the Core Balanced Composite returned 11.26% gross and 10.31% net of fees; over five years, 8.14% gross and 7.22% net annualized; and since its July 1, 2018 inception, 8.02% gross and 7.10% net annualized.
decoys.why_ok: The composite began July 1, 2018, so one-year, five-year and since-inception periods ending at the most recent calendar year-end, with the life of the portfolio substituted for ten years as the page states, satisfy the time-period requirement, with gross and net side by side.
